```{r load-data}
# Set working directory and load data setwd(params$base_output_dir)

original_data_path= file.path(params$OUTPUT_RES_DIR, "cardiomet_risk_adj_embeddings.csv")
net_res_path= paste0(params$OUTPUT_RES_DIR, "/GGM_adj_main_par_full.RData")
outcome_of_interest= "Baseline"
foldname <- file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "/network_analysis")
dir.create(foldname, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load network results

cat("Loading data from:", original_data_path, "\n")
data <- read.csv(original_data_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Extract results
est_adj_matrix <- results$results$Dic_adj_matrics
events_names <- colnames(results$additional_info$z)

cat("Analysis for outcome:", outcome_of_interest, "\n")

cat("Number of diseases:", length(disease_names), "\n")
```

# 1. Network Construction and Basic Properties

```{r network-construction}
# Create network from precision matrix
outcome_df <- est_adj_matrix[[outcome_of_interest]]
fix_col <- function(name) {
  name <- gsub("\\.\\.", ", ", name, perl = TRUE)
  name <- gsub("\\.", " ", name, perl = TRUE)
  name <- gsub("\\s+", " ", name, perl = TRUE)
  trimws(name)
}
rownames(outcome_df) <- fix_col(rownames(outcome_df))
colnames(outcome_df) <- fix_col(colnames(outcome_df))
outcome_matrix <- as.matrix(abs(outcome_df))
cat("Matrix is symmetric:", isSymmetric(outcome_matrix, check.attributes = FALSE), "\n")

disease_names <- fix_col(disease_names)

# Create igraph object
g_est <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  outcome_matrix, 
  mode = "undirected", 
  diag = FALSE, 
  weighted = TRUE, 
  add.colnames = NA, 
  add.rownames = NULL
)

g_abs <- induced_subgraph(g_est, vids = disease_names, impl = "copy_and_delete")

# Basic network statistics
edge_density_val <- edge_density(g_abs, loops = FALSE)
diameter_val <- diameter(g_abs, directed = FALSE, weights = NA)

network_stats <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Nodes", "Edges", "Edge Density", "Diameter"),
  Value = c(
    vcount(g_abs),
    ecount(g_abs),
    round(edge_density_val, 4),
    diameter_val
  )
)

kable(network_stats, caption = "Basic Network Statistics") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

cat("Nodes (V):", vcount(g_abs), "\n")
cat("Edges (E):", ecount(g_abs), "\n")
cat("Edge density:", round(edge_density_val, 4), "\n")
cat("Diameter:", diameter_val, "\n")
```

## Edge Weight Distribution

```{r edge-distribution}
# Analyze edge weights
UP <- outcome_matrix[upper.tri(outcome_matrix, diag = FALSE)]
non_zero_edges <- sum(UP != 0)

edge_stats <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Min", "1st Qu.", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu.", "Max", "Non-zero edges"),
  Value = c(summary(UP), non_zero_edges)
)

kable(edge_stats, caption = "Edge Weight Statistics", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Plot edge weight distribution
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(UP, breaks = 100, main = "Edge Weight Distribution", xlab = "Edge Weight", col = params$color_net_plots)
plot(density(UP), main = "Edge Weight Density", xlab = "Edge Weight", col = params$color_net_plots, lwd = 2)
```

# 3. Community Detection
```{r community-detection-helper-function}
run_community_detection <- function(g_undir, method) {
  community_obj <- switch(
    method,
    "cfg" = cluster_fast_greedy(g_undir, weights = NA),
    "cfg_weighted" = cluster_fast_greedy(g_undir),
    "leid" = cluster_leiden(
      g_undir,
      objective_function = "modularity",
      weights = NA
    ),
    "leid_weighted" = cluster_leiden(
      g_undir,
      objective_function = "modularity"
    ),
    "btw_cluster" = cluster_edge_betweenness(
      g_undir,
      weights = NA
    ),
    stop(
      "Unknown community detection algorithm: ", method,
      "\nChoose one of: cfg, cfg_weighted, leid, leid_weighted, btw_cluster"
    )
  )
  return(community_obj)
}
```

```{r community-detection, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# Community detection using fast greedy algorithm
community_obj <- run_community_detection(
  as.undirected(g_abs),
  params$community_detection_algorithm
)
V(g_abs)$community <- community_obj$membership

num_communities <- length(unique(V(g_abs)$community))
cat("Number of communities detected:", num_communities, "\n")

# Community size distribution
community_sizes <- table(V(g_abs)$community)
community_stats <- data.frame(
  Community = names(community_sizes),
  Size = as.numeric(community_sizes)
)

kable(head(community_stats[order(community_stats$Size, decreasing = TRUE), ], 10), 
      caption = "Top 10 Largest Communities", row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

# Create color palette for communities
num_colors <- length(unique(V(g_abs)$community))
colrs <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(min(12, num_colors), "Pastel1"))(num_colors)

# Save community plot
plot_name <- file.path(foldname, "Plots_comoribity_graph_communities.png")
png(filename = plot_name, width = 3000, height = 3000, res = 400)
plot(g_abs,
     layout = layout,
     edge.arrow.size = 1,
     vertex.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.size = 5,
     vertex.frame.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.label.cex = 0.5,
     edge.curved = 0.2,
     edge.color = "gray60",
     edge.width = 0.1,
     margin = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
dev.off()

plot_name <- file.path(foldname, "Plots_comoribity_graph_communities.svg")
svg(plot_name, width = 10, height = 10)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(g_abs,
     layout = layout,  # same layout object
     edge.arrow.size = 0.2,
     vertex.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.size = 8,
     vertex.frame.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.frame.width = 1,
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.label.cex = 1,
     vertex.label.family = "sans",
     edge.curved = 0.2,
     edge.color = grDevices::adjustcolor("gray60", alpha.f = 0.6),
     edge.width = 0.7,
     margin = 0)
dev.off()


# Display community plot in report
plot(g_abs,
     layout = layout,
     edge.arrow.size = 1,
     vertex.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.size = 5,
     vertex.frame.color = colrs[V(g_abs)$community],
     vertex.label.color = "black",
     vertex.label.cex = 0.5,
     edge.curved = 0.2,
     edge.color = "gray60",
     edge.width = 0.1,
     margin = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
     main = paste("Community Structure (", num_communities, "communities)"))
```

# 4. Node Centrality Analysis

```{r centrality-analysis}
# Calculate centrality measures
node_topology_summary <- data.frame(
  Node = V(g_abs)$name,
  Community = V(g_abs)$community
)

idx <- match(node_topology_summary$Node, V(g_abs)$name)

# Calculate various centrality measures
deg <- degree(g_abs, mode = "all")
node_topology_summary$centrality_degree <- deg[idx]


node_topology_summary$betweenness <- as.numeric(betweenness(
  g_abs, 
  directed = FALSE, 
  weights = NA
)[idx])


write.csv(node_topology_summary, file = file.path(params$OUTPUT_RES_DIR,"Node_Community_detection_centrality.csv"), row.names = F)

cat("Network analysis summary:\n")
node_topology_summary
```
